target_pdb.description: Path to a target structure (.pdb or .cif). When provided, the adapter generates a minimal BoltzGen design YAML using ``target_chain`` and ``binder_length``.

target_yaml.description: Path to a BoltzGen-format design specification YAML. Mutually exclusive with ``target_pdb``.

target_chain.description: Target chain id to bind against (used only when generating a YAML from ``target_pdb``).

binder_length.description: Fixed length of the binder chain (used only when generating a YAML from ``target_pdb``).

num_designs.description: Number of design backbones to generate.

num_diffusion_steps.description: Number of denoising steps per sample. Lower means faster, lower quality.

protocol.description: BoltzGen protocol controlling which pipeline steps run and the default model choices.

design_only.description: If true, run only the diffusion backbone generation step. If false, run the full pipeline (design + inverse_fold + folding + analyze + filter).

budget.description: Final ranked design set size (only meaningful when ``design_only`` is false).

seed.description: Optional random seed forwarded to BoltzGen via PYTHONHASHSEED.
